baseline_reuse: Saved contexts, scoring and metrics; do not retrieve B8 again

controls.packing: Unchanged run_retrieval_eval_v1.packed_b; child hit maps to its full original parent; same original parent corpus and section branch expansion
controls.selection: First 8 threshold/geography-eligible child hits, sorted by cosine then child ID. Duplicate parent/branch hits consume child slots; unchanged packer deduplicates. NO refill to 8 unique parents.
controls.query_vectors: Reuse all 15 saved original queries/vectors; no rewriting or embedding query changes
controls.embedding_model: Existing locked local paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 ONNX; same tokenizer, CPU provider, threads=4, batch_size=16, pooling and normalisation
controls.embedding_format: Normalise title/section/text vector and body-only vector separately, average, then normalise; production text-context-mean-v1
controls.unchanged_children: If full parent fits both views, retain exact text and reuse its existing stored vector, avoiding irrelevant batch/runtime recomputation differences
controls.context_tokenizer: Same llama-tokenize binary and locked Qwen GGUF; tokenization only

chunking.scope: Split only within existing passages; never merge or alter original source text or metadata
chunking.length_rule: Both complete body-only and unchanged title + '. ' + section + '. ' + body inputs must fit <=128 including special tokens. Actual FastEmbed loader tokenizer plus untruncated/no-padding diagnostic clone used for verification.
chunking.boundary_preference: Greedily use the last fitting paragraph/newline or sentence end; if none fit, last fitting word end; token-offset end only when a single word exceeds capacity
chunking.overlap_rule: For split parents, retain the longest trailing word-aligned substring of the previous child with <=16 body tokens excluding specials. Drop overlap only if it prevents forward progress. No overlap across parents.
chunking.metadata_overflow: Abort if unchanged metadata leaves no room; do not shorten titles or sections
chunking.provenance: Every child stores original parent/source/document/section, exact start/end character offsets, exact text, embedding inputs and token IDs
chunking.coverage_validation: Every original character is covered by child spans; every span exactly equals the original substring; zero actual truncated embedding inputs required

scoring.protocol: Same frozen information-based rules as B8; strict binary items with all required conditions; supporting sources optional; cream conflict excluded; sleeping mat optional
scoring.ranking_diagnosis: Use prior corpus-evidence locations for audit, not chunk-ID pass criteria. Report both best child of relevant parent and child(s) actually containing required text; all-child and projected unique-parent ranks separately. No projected-parent rerun or third variant.
scoring.stop: One C8 run, return report and one proposed next experiment; owner review required
